questions.text: A data file consisting of 1,50,000 student-records is stored on a hard disk with block size of 4096 bytes. The data file is sorted on the primary key RollNo. The size of a record pointer for this disk is 7 bytes. Each student-record has a candidate key attribute called ANum of size 12 bytes. Suppose an index file with records consisting of two fields, ANum value and the record pointer the corresponding student record, is built and stored on the same disk. Assume that the records of data file and index file are not split across disk blocks. The number of blocks in the index file is ______
questions.solution:
ANum is not the sorting key, so the index must be dense: one entry per record.

Entry size = 12 + 7 = 19 bytes [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] entries per block = [latex]\lfloor4096/19\rfloor=215[/latex].
Blocks = [latex]\lceil150000/215\rceil=698[/latex]

Answer: 698

questions.text: For a given biased coin, the probability that the outcome of a toss is a head is 0.4. This coin is tossed 1,000 times. Let X denote the random variable whose value is the number of times that head appeared in these 1,000 tosses. The standard deviation of X (rounded to 2 decimal place) is ________
questions.solution:
X is binomial with n = 1000, p = 0.4.
[latex]\sigma=\sqrt{np(1-p)}=\sqrt{1000\times0.4\times0.6}=\sqrt{240}\approx15.49[/latex]

Answer: 15.49

questions.text: Suppose that P is a 4x5 matrix such that every solution of the equation Px=0 is a scalar multiple of [latex]\begin{bmatrix} 2 & 5 & 4 &3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}^T[/latex]. The rank of P is _______
questions.solution:
All solutions of Px = 0 are multiples of one vector [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] nullity = 1.
P has 5 columns, so by rank-nullity: rank = 5 [latex]-[/latex] 1 = 4.

Answer: 4

questions.text: Suppose that [latex]f: \mathbb{R} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}[/latex] is a continuous function on the interval [-3,3] and a differentiable function in the interval (-3,3) such that for every [latex]x[/latex] in the interval, [latex]f'(x) \leq 2[/latex]. If [latex]f(-3) =7[/latex], then [latex]f(3) [/latex] is at most __________
questions.solution:
By the mean value theorem, [latex]f(3)-f(-3)=f'(c)\cdot6\le2\times6=12[/latex].

[latex]f(3)\le7+12=19[/latex]

Answer: 19
